tours.title: Horseback Riding Tours
tours.subtitle: Discover the natural beauty of La Fortuna on horseback, guided through forest trails and river crossings by our experienced local team.

card.title: Nature Trail Horseback Tour
card.description: Live an authentic horseback adventure through tropical forest trails, crossing streams and discovering the breathtaking landscapes of La Fortuna alongside our skilled local guides.

about.title: Our History
about.imgAlt1: Family riding horses at El Abanico
about.para1b: After years of working the land and raising horses in El Abanico, two partners chose to share the beauty surrounding us with the world — and to let nature be the guide.
about.para2: That decision became this project: a place where our horses, our trails, and the untouched nature of Costa Rica come together to create memories that visitors carry home forever. We are not a company. We are two partners who open the gates of their home.
about.quote: You won't find the luxury of a hotel here. But you will find something far more powerful: the warmth of those who ride beside you, the silence of the forest, and the feeling that, for a moment, the world slowed down just for you.
about.para3a: In 2026, we took our first steps into the digital world. Come and be part of our story, and discover the
about.para3b: that only a family-run adventure can truly offer.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our horseback riding tour

q1.q: Is prior horseback riding experience required?
q1.a: No experience needed. Our horses are calm and well-trained, and your guide will give you a brief orientation before the ride. Perfect for first-timers.

q2.q: Is the tour suitable for children?
q2.a: Absolutely. The tour is designed for all ages. Our horses are gentle and our guides are experienced with young riders. Children must be accompanied by an adult.

q3.q: Do children pay a different price?
q3.a: Yes, we offer a reduced rate for children under 12. Contact us for exact pricing — we love welcoming families.

q4.q: Is the horseback riding tour safe?
q4.a: Safety is our top priority. All riders receive helmets, our horses are trained for trail riding, and an experienced guide accompanies the group at all times.

q5.q: What will we see during the tour?
q5.a: You'll ride through tropical forest trails, cross crystal-clear streams, and enjoy stunning views of the Arenal Volcano and the mountains surrounding La Fortuna.

q6.q: How long does the tour last?
q6.a: The standard tour lasts approximately 2.5 to 3 hours. We also offer extended options — ask us about custom experiences.

q7.q: What should I wear for the tour?
q7.a: Wear comfortable long pants and closed-toe shoes. Bring sunscreen, a light jacket, and a small water bottle. Helmets are provided at no extra cost.

q8.a: Costa Rica is tropical — light rain is part of the magic! For heavy rain or storms, we will work with you to reschedule at no extra cost.

location.title: How to Find Us
location.subtitle: Finca El Abanico is located just a few minutes from downtown La Fortuna, near the Arenal Volcano. From the central park, take Route 702 south toward Chachagua — you will find us along the way.

whatToBring.title: What to Bring
whatToBring.subtitle: We provide all necessary riding equipment. Here's what we recommend you bring for the best experience.
whatToBring.item1Desc: Sunscreen and a hat if you wish.
whatToBring.item3Desc: Hiking shoes or boots for added safety.
whatToBring.item4Desc: Jeans or leggings for better comfort.
whatToBring.item5Desc: Bring water to stay hydrated during the tour.
whatToBring.item6Desc: Recommended for rain or river crossings.

horses.title: Meet Our Horses
horses.subtitle: Each one with their own personality — calm, trained, and ready to take you on a one-of-a-kind adventure.

toursPage.videoSubtitle: Watch the breathtaking landscapes, river crossings, and unforgettable moments waiting for you at El Abanico.
toursPage.timelineSubtitle: Follow the trail through the heart of La Fortuna's nature — each stop a new discovery.
toursPage.stop1Desc: Your adventure begins at Finca El Abanico, where you'll meet your guide and your horse. Breathe in the farm air, surrounded by lush tropical forest.
toursPage.stop2Desc: Ride into the heart of the jungle on ancient trails. Listen to the birds, breathe in the cool forest air, and let the towering canopy shelter you above.
toursPage.stop3Desc: Feel the rush as your horse wades through crystal-clear streams. One of the most magical and memorable moments of the entire tour.
toursPage.stop4Desc: Emerge from the forest into open fields with sweeping panoramic views of the Arenal Volcano and the mountains surrounding La Fortuna.
toursPage.stop5Desc: Head back under golden light as the day winds down — carrying memories that will last a lifetime, and hooves that have earned their rest.
